hero.heading: Technology with purpose.
hero.subheading: We help businesses solve digital problems — and figure out what to build next.

who.label: Who We Are
who.heading: A founder-led Digital Technology Partner.
who.text1: SQ Interactive is based in Lahore, Pakistan. We work alongside businesses to understand what is actually getting in the way, identify where technology can create value, and build practical solutions around those needs.
who.text2: That can mean a better website, a digital system, an AI workflow, business automation, custom software, an immersive experience — or something that doesn't fit neatly into a category yet.
who.text3: We don't start with a technology and look for somewhere to use it. We start with the problem.

why.label: Why SQ Exists
why.heading: Bridging the gap between business and technology.
why.text1: Technology moves quickly. For a business, keeping up with every new platform, tool, AI model, automation system, or digital trend can create as many questions as answers.
why.text2: What should we actually use? What is worth building? What will make a difference? What will simply add complexity?
why.text3: SQ Interactive exists to bridge that gap. Our purpose is to make modern technology practical, accessible, and valuable for businesses — helping organizations use technology effectively without having to become technology experts themselves.
why.text4: We believe technology should solve business problems, not create new ones.

positioning.label: Our Positioning
positioning.heading: Not just another technology vendor.
positioning.text1: SQ Interactive is not built around selling isolated services. We see ourselves as a technology partner.
positioning.text2: That means understanding the business before recommending a solution, being honest about what is and isn't necessary, and staying involved when a project needs improvement, maintenance, training, or continued technical support.
positioning.text3: Our positioning is deliberately technology-agnostic. We don't recommend a technology because it is popular. We recommend what makes sense for the problem.

origin.label: Our Story
origin.heading: From one laptop to a technology company.
origin.text1: SQ Interactive began from a small room in Lahore. The company was built through experimentation — combining design, development, 3D, immersive technology, and emerging AI systems to see what could actually be made.
origin.text2: The early work was heavily focused on websites, immersive experiences, digital media, and visualization. Those projects became the foundation for the broader technology capabilities SQ is developing today.

versions.v1Desc: Websites, immersive technologies, digital media, and technical experimentation. Establishing the initial portfolio.
versions.v2Desc: Expanding beyond specialist services into a broader Digital Technology Partner capable of solving different kinds of business challenges.
versions.v3Desc: Software platforms, AI products, automation systems, immersive technologies, research, and intellectual property for global markets.

capabilities.label: What We Bring
capabilities.heading: Capabilities across multiple areas of technology.
capabilities.subheading: Real business problems rarely fit neatly into one category. Our capabilities can stand alone, but they can also work together when a problem requires a broader solution.

digital.title: Digital
digital.desc: Websites, e-commerce, Shopify, UI/UX, digital products, SEO, systems, and digital experiences.

ai.title: AI
ai.desc: Artificial intelligence solutions, AI visualization, intelligent workflows, and practical AI adoption.

automation.title: Automation & Systems
automation.desc: Business automation, databases, integrations, custom software, and systems that reduce unnecessary manual work.

immersive.title: Immersive
immersive.desc: VR, AR, 360° experiences, interactive 3D, visualization, and other immersive technologies.

support.title: Technology Support
support.desc: Hosting, maintenance, optimization, training, technical support, and ongoing improvement.

clients.label: Who We Work With
clients.heading: Businesses that are trying to improve something.
clients.text: SQ's current focus is particularly relevant to construction, real estate, hospitality, and businesses looking for broader digital transformation, while the company's capabilities are designed to expand into additional sectors over time.

useCases.case8: Presenting a property, product, or idea differently
useCases.case9: Figuring out where technology can create a new opportunity

future.label: Where We're Going
future.heading: Built in Pakistan. Thinking beyond it.
future.text1: SQ Interactive is based in Lahore. Our foundation is local, but our ambitions are not limited by geography. The long-term direction is to grow from a founder-led technology partner into an internationally recognized technology company.
future.text2: Over time, we intend to develop software products, AI systems, automation, immersive technologies, research & innovation, and intellectual property for wider markets.
future.text3: The objective is not growth for its own sake. It is to build a company capable of creating technology that has lasting value.

promise.label: Our Promise
promise.heading: Come to us with a problem. Leave with a plan.
promise.subheading: We'll listen. We'll understand the situation. We'll tell you what makes sense. We'll build what is needed. And when we see an opportunity beyond the original problem, we'll show you that too.
promise.note: No pressure. No sales pitch. Just a genuine conversation about your business.
